title: Work that follows from a result Daniel accepted reaches him only when it is a question with a recommended answer
tier_reason: changes how follow-ups are filed; git reverts it
ask: Build the spawn rule (S-17, docs/QUEUE_TO_ZERO.md §5) in hq/work.py _file_follow_ups and _parse_follows: a follow-up with no tier is tier 1, never 2; a tier-2 follow-up is filed as a decision to prep (a card in a new `prepping` state owned by the follow-up's owner, whose result must carry `recommend` with question, answer, why, instead before it may enter needs_approval); a follow-up whose owner and normalised title match an open card merges into it (append the ask, record `merged_from`); a child carries `promised_by` = the parent card so a landed result that matches its promise never returns; snapshot()'s waiting_on_you counts only for_review and needs_approval cards that carry a recommendation. Tests for each rule.
first_action: Read §5 and work_policy.json `spawn`; write the merge key and the prepping state first, since the drain item depends on neither.
source_message: Daniel said yes to the arrival rule (S-16) and the spawn rule (S-17) on 2026-09-20; docs/QUEUE_TO_ZERO.md §12 is the build order.
